full_judgment: 17. Before parting with this record, it may be mentioned here that the learned Advocate for the appellant referred to a decision in the case of Fazlul Haque vs State reported in 11 DLR 316 which dealt with presumption of certain facts for non-examination of material witnesses. It is true that the prosecution did not examine all the charge-sheeted witnesses but in the facts and circumstances of the present case we are of opinion that the ruling as referred to above is not applicable in the present case in view of peculiar circumstances as observed by their Lordships in the decision so reported in 54 DLR (AD) 78.
